output.headline: Midwest-active sponsor with a provider record and a median 15.2x paid, able to underwrite a new platform at upper-quartile pricing.
output.differentiator: Six of its 14 deals were in the Midwest, and its median 15.2x paid sits at the top of the comparable range. It would need to treat the target as a new platform.
output.why_them: Midwest provider specialist; pays upper-quartile multiples; target would be a new platform

acquirer_overview.title: Provider-focused sponsor with deep Midwest roots and a large fund
points: Financial sponsor with 14 deals from 2015 to 2023; 9 of 14 were provider deals, and 12 of 14 were control deals [T:record, A:angles, K:control_share].
Fund XIV is $11.5 billion, and its mandate covers healthcare among other sectors [P:1, P:2].
Median deal is $173M, with 4 of 14 in the $100M-$400M band the target sits in [T:record, K:size_band].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Provider specialist with Midwest precedents, building a new platform here
points: It has 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; 6 deals were in the Midwest [T:record, K:by_region].
Platform Build is a motive in 5 of 14 deals, a pattern that stands out against the file as a whole [M:platform_build].
No open platform in the sub-sector, so the target would be a fresh platform rather than an add-on [A:angles, C:conviction].

precedent_activity.title: Closed large Midwest provider deals at multiples near the top of the range
points: Sterling Health Systems: $911M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2018, Midwest, same sub-sector as the target, 12.2x EV/EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2018-0357].
Golden Orthodontics: $588M Leveraged Buyout, 2020, Midwest dental, 15.2x EV/EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2020-0276].
Superior Behavioral Health, $70M, 2023, closed at 14.6x; Zenith Specialty Care, $76M, 2023, was withdrawn [D:MA-2023-0293, D:MA-2023-0279].

valuation_context.title: Target merits the 75th percentile; GTCR's own multiples can support it
points: 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median and 15.3x at the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Margin of 16.8% against a comps median of 12.9% supports the 75th percentile, which needs $13.1M of EBITDA [V:comps].
GTCR's median paid is 15.2x. At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M and IRR at the ask is 18.7% [V:comps, V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below its 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: On the same exit the maximum is $193M, below the $200M EV [V:lbo, X:target].

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: The share of its deals that closed counts slightly against it [S:close_rate_s].
risk_flags.mitigant: 11 of 14 deals closed (79%), including Sterling and Golden Orthodontics in the Midwest [K:closed_share, D:MA-2018-0357, D:MA-2020-0276].
risk_flags.reality: One 2023 Midwest bolt-on, Zenith, was withdrawn, so process certainty needs testing [D:MA-2023-0279].

risk_flags.title: No open platform
risk_flags.concern: No open platform in the target's sub-sector, so no ready add-on logic [A:angles].
risk_flags.mitigant: 9 of 14 deals were provider deals, and 6 were in the Midwest [A:angles, K:by_region].
risk_flags.reality: It is 8th on the priority list, with a likelihood of 3.8% [R:rank].

conviction.rationale: Supported by 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; held back because there is no open platform in the sub-sector [C:conviction, A:angles].
